notes: Data sourced from Financial Datasets REST API for WMT (Walmart) fiscal Q3 2026, period ending 2025-10-31.
Fiscal year 2026 per Walmart's fiscal calendar (Feb 1 - Jan 31); Q3 ends October 31, 2025.
Revenue, net_income from income statement; total_assets from balance sheet; operating_cash_flow and capital_expenditure from cash flow statement.
capital_expenditures uses the 'capital_expenditure' field (18627000000) as a positive outflow.
Cash flow statement figures in 10-Q filings are cumulative YTD (9-month); the API reports them under the quarterly period label.
net_margin = net_income / revenue; free_cash_flow_margin = free_cash_flow / revenue.
